en.title: Per-Second Request Count of a FIFO Queue
en.description:
At time 0 all requests join the queue. Each second the front request is processed; it still counts toward that second's size and is removed the following second. Every other request expires and is removed immediately at t=wait[i], and it can only start being served while t<wait[i]. Output the queue length at every second from time 0 until the queue is empty, including the final 0.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n waiting deadlines. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤wait[i]≤100000.
en.output: Output the queue length at each time, separated by spaces; the last value is 0.
hints: Bucket indices by deadline, and maintain the queue front with alive flags and a forward-moving pointer. Each second, remove the request that was served, then remove the still-alive requests in the bucket that expires now.
